def month_series(tsid,label):

    for t,v in d.items():

content.text: The data only contains zone air temperature sensor readings and heating/cooling setpoints — no independent temperature cross-reference, load, occupancy, or airflow streams. A persistent ~2 °C elevation of the F3_Z01 sensor relative to adjacent zones after July 2018 is consistent with both a genuine zone temperature rise (local load change) and a sensor offset/drift, and with only this single sensor reading the two are indistinguishable.
